HR Leave Policy

Employees are eligible for 18 annual leave days per year.
Leave approval: MANAGER approves employee leave; HR audits monthly.
Sick leave requires a doctor's note if more than 2 consecutive days.
Payroll questions must be raised to HR only.

# Meeting Rooms

## Rooms
- Board Room (capacity 20) - BOOKABLE_BY: MANAGER, ADMIN
- Alpha Room (capacity 8) - BOOKABLE_BY: EMPLOYEE, MANAGER, HR, ADMIN

## Booking Rules
Bookings can be made up to 14 days in advance.
Cancellations should be done at least 2 hours before the meeting.

Office Policy

Office hours: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM IST.
Visitors must register at reception.
Employees can book meeting rooms using the internal portal.
The Board Room is bookable only by MANAGER and ADMIN.

Vendor Contract: ACME Internet

Service: Office internet connectivity.
SLA: Response within 4 hours for downtime incidents.
Penalty: 2% monthly fee rebate if SLA missed more than 3 times.
Contract value: Confidential.
